messages.content:
Existing current facts about entities this note mentions:
- memory_id "1000780" [decision]: As of 2025-10-13, ownership of the ledger service transferred to Cinder from the Atlas team.  (about: Atlas team, Cinder, ledger service)
- memory_id "1000776": As of 2025-10-13, the pager for the ledger service rings Cinder instead of the Atlas team.  (about: Atlas team, Cinder, ledger service)
- memory_id "1000771": In INC-2025-023, the indexer served stale results for two days starting 2025-10-03 because a reindex job failed silently on a full disk.  (about: indexer)
- memory_id "1000759": On 2025-09-23 the Dune team noticed that the bus' CPU sat at 90 percent after the traffic shift and pinged the owners.  (about: Dune team, the bus)
- memory_id "1000722" [decision]: The job scheduler was owned by the Dune team from 2025-06-25, having moved from the Ember team, until ownership transferred to Cinder on 2025-09-23.  (about: Cinder, Dune team, Ember team, job scheduler)
- memory_id "1000716" [decision]: As of 2025-09-05, the Dune team still owned the job scheduler; ownership transferred to Cinder on 2025-09-23.  (about: Cinder, Dune team, job scheduler)
- memory_id "1000712": As of 2025-09-23, the pager for the job scheduler rings Cinder instead of the Dune team.  (about: Cinder, Dune team, job scheduler)
- memory_id "1000674": On 2025-09-03 the Cinder team observed that the auth gateway's cold start time tripled after the runtime upgrade.  (about: Cinder, auth gateway)
- memory_id "1000649": On 2025-08-19 the Dune team observed that the resizer's cold start time tripled after the runtime upgrade.  (about: Dune team, resizer)
- memory_id "1000574" [constraint]: Per Ember team policy, every authentication gateway change requires two reviewer approvals and a security sign-off.  (about: Ember team, authentication gateway)
- memory_id "1000548": The billing API is owned by the Atlas team as of 2025-06-09, having moved from the Ember team; the Boreal team was recorded by mistake and never held it.  (about: Atlas team, Boreal team, billing API, Ember team)
- memory_id "1000514": The notifier is owned by the Dune team as of 2025-06-27; the earlier handover note of 2025-06-11 saying Cinder took ownership was written against the wrong team, and Cinder never owned it.  (about: Cinder, Dune team, notifier)
- memory_id "1000453" [decision]: On 2025-06-06 the Ember team decided that the job scheduler will use leader election instead of a single fixed node.  (about: Ember team, job scheduler)
- memory_id "1000424" [decision]: The indexer is owned by the Atlas team as of 2025-05-20, taking over from Cinder.  (about: Atlas team, Cinder, indexer)
- memory_id "1000404": On 2025-05-14 the Cinder team observed that webhooks' memory use grew steadily for a week after the cache change.  (about: Cinder, webhooks)
- memory_id "1000364": As of 2025-04-24, the Cinder team reported that the feature-flags service's p99 latency doubled after Tuesday's deploy.  (about: Cinder, feature-flags)
- memory_id "1000343": The product catalog keeps image metadata in a separate table because the joined writes were locking product updates for seconds at a time.  (about: product catalog)
- memory_id "1000328": The image resizer is a hard dependency of the product catalog.  (about: product catalog, image resizer)
- memory_id "1000325": The product catalog calls the image resizer for thumbnails.  (about: product catalog, image resizer)
- memory_id "1000321": As of 2025-04-07, the Ember team reported that the notifier's request volume halved after the client rollout.  (about: notifier, Ember team)
- memory_id "1000276": The image resizer is owned by the Ember team as of 2025-03-20.  (about: Ember team, image resizer)
Existing entity names: Atlas team, Cinder, ledger service, indexer, Dune team, the bus, Ember team, job scheduler, auth gateway, resizer, authentication gateway, Boreal team, billing API, notifier, webhooks, feature-flags, product catalog, image resizer
